games.name: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang
games.gameplay: A fast, mobile-first 5v5 MOBA built for quick matches and nonstop action. Choose from tanks, mages, assassins, marksmen, and supports, jump into lane battles, steal buffs, and unleash flashy ultimates. Easy to learn, hard to stop playing 😄🔥

games.name: Arena of Valor
games.gameplay: A more traditional and competitive MOBA experience with polished maps, detailed heroes, and skill-based combat. Matches reward smart rotations, clean combos, and strong teamwork—perfect for players who love strategy and precision 🎯⚡

games.name: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang
games.graphics: Bright, cartoon-style 3D visuals with smooth animations 🎨

faqs.question: Which MOBA is easier for beginners?
faqs.answer: Mobile Legends is easier to learn thanks to simpler controls and shorter matches 😄

faqs.question: Which game has better graphics?
faqs.answer: Arena of Valor stands out with more realistic heroes and cinematic skill effects 🎥

faqs.question: Which game runs better on low-end devices?
faqs.answer: Mobile Legends is lighter and performs better on budget and older phones 📱

faqs.question: Which is better for competitive and esports play?
faqs.answer: Arena of Valor offers deeper strategy and a stronger competitive ecosystem 🏆
